source_snapshot: previously pinned external architecture frontier, GitHub bytes re-read at each exact pin for LICENSE, pyproject metadata and API docs
rules: A source qualification is not install qualification
An install qualification is not protocol qualification
An attributed mock test is not vendor execution
A vendor execution is not accepted same-harness evidence
Exact-source comparisons require native source traceability; no semantic text-to-id guesses
Do not invent zero for unsupported operations
No unapproved paid LLMs or hosted CI

systems.api_surface: Graphiti.add_episode and Graphiti.search; public temporal-graph source
systems.adapter_semantics: Episode ingestion; edge provenance may identify one or multiple episodes. Native search hits must be traced to benchmark source episodes; graph association alone is not exact-source attribution.
systems.required_backend: Neo4j/FalkorDB or other configured supported graph database
systems.model_requirement: LLM+embedder provider for graph construction; default uses OpenAI, local OpenAI-compatible may be attempted as a separate pinned profile
systems.next_gate: Execute real Graphiti add_episode(uuid=...) -> search() with pinned graph DB/LLM/embedder and verify every EntityEdge.episodes handle resolves to an actual same-input episode, with mixed-source edges excluded from exact-source credit.
systems.identity_risk: An edge may be supported by several source episodes; assigning it arbitrarily to a benchmark item is a false positive.
systems.profile_caveat: OSS Graphiti is not the proprietary Zep cloud service.
systems.source_id_evidence: EntityEdge.episodes:list[str] references source episode UUIDs; Graphiti.add_episode accepts optional caller UUID; Graphiti.search returns EntityEdge[]

systems.api_surface: cognee.add + cognify + search(query_text, query_type=SearchType.CHUNKS, datasets=..., top_k=...); source inspected in cognee/api/v1/search/search.py
systems.adapter_semantics: Do not score generated GRAPH_COMPLETION text as a retrieved source ID; raw CHUNKS may require source_data_id linking back to ingested data documents. Mapping unverified at this revision.
systems.required_backend: Local Cognee data/vector/graph backend with per-case namespace isolation and reset proof
systems.model_requirement: LLM and embedding model for cognify; package includes remote-provider dependencies and local options, which must be pinned separately
systems.next_gate: Determine whether CHUNKS returns a lossless verified ingest source linkage. If not, refuse exact-source lane and choose a protocol in which graph completion is evaluated as QA with a frozen answer judge.
systems.identity_risk: Chunk content or graph answer is not a valid alias for a frozen benchmark item ID.
systems.profile_caveat: Graph completion QA and CHUNKS retrieval measure different protocols.

systems.api_surface: HindsightClient.retain, recall, reflect; self-hosted server via hindsight-all
systems.adapter_semantics: Retain and recall expose retrieved knowledge but exact-source ID mapping must be proven independent of response text; reflect is not retrieval parity.
systems.model_requirement: LLM extraction/reflect configuration is profile-specific, see #640
systems.next_gate: Do not duplicate #640. Pin exact install/model/runtime in its existing workstream; require a new lane freeze before any accepted numeric row.
systems.identity_risk: Extracted facts can combine/transform source documents and break exact-ID retrieval scoring.
systems.profile_caveat: Vendor LongMemEval QA references are not same-harness retrieval measurements.
